arguments.prompt: Create a purely nonrepresentational abstract painting, square in format, filling the entire image edge to edge. Use only color, contrast, brushwork, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. Concentrate overlapping charcoal, deep plum, and muted rust strokes in an irregular area toward the upper left. Build palpable density through dry brush drag, thin translucent washes, impasto ridges, and scraped passages. Let the compressed rhythm loosen gradually across the surface into pale warm gray and muted apricot, with longer, more spacious gestures and broad intervals of quiet painted space toward the lower right. Keep all boundaries irregular and painterly, with subtle interwoven color echoes across the transition. Maintain an asymmetrical composition and a nuanced balance between compression and openness. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, records, tiles, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. No frame, wall, room, or gallery setting.

response.composition: A dense dark mass is weighted toward the upper left. Its irregular diagonal boundary descends toward the lower left and opens into a much larger pale field across the right and bottom. Small warm orange accents link the two areas without forming a defined scene.
response.constraint_evidence: The visible forms are irregular paint patches, strokes, scratches, and drips. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, landscape, horizon, diagram, symbol, letter, number, or text is apparent.
response.description: A square abstract painting with thick, scraped paint. Dense black, charcoal, plum, and rusty orange occupy the upper left, with sharp overlapping strokes and several dark drips. These masses break into gray, mauve, and cream patches toward the center. Broad ivory, pale peach, and warm gray strokes cover the right and lower areas, with faint orange streaks and visible ridges in the paint.
response.reconstructed_prompt: Create a square, purely nonrepresentational impasto painting. Cluster black, charcoal, deep plum, mauve, and rusty orange palette-knife marks in the upper-left area. Use jagged overlaps, scraped patches, a few scratches, and short vertical black drips. Let this dark region fragment diagonally into a broad pale field of ivory, warm gray, cream, and peach across the right and lower canvas. Add restrained rusty orange streaks among the pale paint. Show tactile ridges, thick scraped paint, and varied broad diagonal strokes. Keep every form abstract, with no objects, figures, faces, landscape, horizon, symbols, or text.
response.uncertainty: The contrast between rough dark paint and open pale paint supports several visual readings. It does not establish a scenario cue or any actual mental state of the creator. The recreation prompt describes visible features and is not a recovered original prompt.
visual_mood: quiet and open in the pale region
